scope: Isolated real C# domain execution plus read-only live observations. No gameplay session or player telemetry is modified. These are NOT end-to-end gameplay or user-experience tests.

checks.name: Five phase order and durations
checks.evidence: Calm(3s) -> BuildUp(15s) -> Combat(60s) -> Peak(15s) -> Relax(20s) -> Calm.

checks.name: Weak HP and recent down trigger Relax
checks.evidence: HP boundary 0.20/0.21 and down grace boundary 20/20.01 seconds verified in domain.

checks.name: Relax boundary is required for DDA
checks.evidence: A high performance fixture outside Relax leaves multiplier 1.0.

checks.name: Both evidence thresholds are required
checks.evidence: 19 shots/8 kills: hold; 20 shots/7 kills: hold; no samples: hold; 20 shots/8 kills: eligible.

checks.name: Weakest eligible player limits team score

checks.evidence: From 1.0 with synthetic score endpoints: Easy 0.85-1; Medium 0.85-1.15; Hard 0.90-1.15; Pandemonium 1-1.15. Every update <=0.10.

checks.name: Spawn pressure outputs and Relax gate
checks.evidence: DDA 1->1.1: interval 2->1.81818s, cap 30->33, chance .15->.165. Relax/cap block new spawn. Factory/gameplay NOT exercised.
